In between attacks, the squad members deal with the other psychological stresses of the war, including the effect on morale of the antiwar movement back home and flashes of racial hostility between white and African-American soldiers, all mediated by the cool-headed medic, Doc (Courtney B. Vance).

Eventually, artist Jack Deebs also enters Cool World and sets his lustful sights on his own creation, a blond bombshell named Holli Would. However, excessive intermingling between cartoons and humans is said to lead to dire consequences, a risk Jack seems ready to take.

programme.title: According to Jim
programme.desc: Narra la vida de una familia del Medio Oeste americano. Jim (Jim Belushi), un exitoso empresario de la construcción, es un hombre de un optimismo desaforado que le hace ver siempre el lado bueno de las cosas. Su mujer Cheryl (Courtney Thorne-Smith) intenta poner un poco de cordura en la familia y, aunque adora a su marido, a veces se enfada por las peregrinas ideas que tiene. El matrimonio tiene tres hijos: Ruby (Taylor Atelian), Gracie (Billi Bruno) y Kyle (Conner Rayburn). ★ 6.5/10

programme.title: La Doña
programme.desc: La Doña es una historia de venganza, seducciones y traiciones basada en la vida de Altagracia, una mujer abusada y con un triste pasado. Víctima de una violación cuando era una adolescente, Altagracia dio a luz a una niña llamada Mónica a quien no pudo criar por ser el recuerdo vivo de su peor experiencia. El destino las unirá cuando se enamoren del mismo hombre, Saúl Aguirre, un abogado defensor de las mujeres y sus causas. Tres mundos se unirán en un choque de razón, resentimiento y amor donde la justicia de la mujer prevalecerá como la gran moraleja y victoria de esta historia. ★ 7.4/10

programme.desc: La Doña es una historia de venganza, seducciones y traiciones basada en la vida de Altagracia, una mujer abusada y con un triste pasado. Víctima de una violación cuando era una adolescente, Altagracia dio a luz a una niña llamada Mónica a quien no pudo criar por ser el recuerdo vivo de su peor experiencia. El destino las unirá cuando se enamoren del mismo hombre, Saúl Aguirre, un abogado defensor de las mujeres y sus causas. Tres mundos se unirán en un choque de razón, resentimiento y amor donde la justicia de la mujer prevalecerá como la gran moraleja y victoria de esta historia. ★ 7.4/10

programme.title: La rosa de Guadalupe
programme.desc:
La rosa de Guadalupe es una serie de televisión mexicana creado por Carlos Mercado Orduña, alusiva a la religión católica en específico a la Virgen de Guadalupe.
Cada episodio es diferente al igual que los personajes y una buena parte del elenco. La trama gira en torno a algún personaje devoto(a) a la Virgen de Guadalupe, quien le ora en busca de que proteja a una tercera persona. Al mismo tiempo, una rosa blanca aparecerá frente a un altar o a una imagen de la Virgen perteneciente a la persona que oró y permanecerá ahí durante el desarrollo de la historia, que es generalmente cuando el problema se agrava. El hecho que dicha rosa aparezca da el significado de que la petición ha sido escuchada.
En el clímax de la historia, que es el momento donde el personaje principal se encuentra en una situación grave, la persona cercana que “pidió” por el afectado intercede y trata de ayudarlo. Solucionado el problema, el personaje principal es “acariciado” por un viento que representa el actuar de la Virgen de Guadalupe, al final del episodio, la rosa blanca desaparece mientras uno de los personajes narra el mensaje propio de cada capítulo a modo de moraleja.
Recuerda que puedes ver esta serie en http://www.wopelis.com o en http://mundotv.pro ★ 7.1/10

programme.title: La rosa de Guadalupe
programme.desc:
La rosa de Guadalupe es una serie de televisión mexicana creado por Carlos Mercado Orduña, alusiva a la religión católica en específico a la Virgen de Guadalupe.
Cada episodio es diferente al igual que los personajes y una buena parte del elenco. La trama gira en torno a algún personaje devoto(a) a la Virgen de Guadalupe, quien le ora en busca de que proteja a una tercera persona. Al mismo tiempo, una rosa blanca aparecerá frente a un altar o a una imagen de la Virgen perteneciente a la persona que oró y permanecerá ahí durante el desarrollo de la historia, que es generalmente cuando el problema se agrava. El hecho que dicha rosa aparezca da el significado de que la petición ha sido escuchada.
En el clímax de la historia, que es el momento donde el personaje principal se encuentra en una situación grave, la persona cercana que “pidió” por el afectado intercede y trata de ayudarlo. Solucionado el problema, el personaje principal es “acariciado” por un viento que representa el actuar de la Virgen de Guadalupe, al final del episodio, la rosa blanca desaparece mientras uno de los personajes narra el mensaje propio de cada capítulo a modo de moraleja.
Recuerda que puedes ver esta serie en http://www.wopelis.com o en http://mundotv.pro ★ 7.1/10

programme.desc: S01 E01 — Crispy Chicken Oven Hack Jamie hacks his oven into a rotisserie for crispy chicken and chips and bakes a savory spinach and feta pie. Then, the Godfather of Spanish cuisine, Jose Pizarro, shares some gorgeous Mediterranean flavours using just 5 everyday ingredients.

programme.title: Jamie Oliver's 5 Ingredient Mediterranean Meals
programme.desc: S01 E02 — Pantry Pasta and Rice Pudding Pops Jamie raids his pantry for a speedy veggie carbonara and rice pudding popsicles.

programme.title: Jamie Oliver's 5 Ingredient Mediterranean Meals
programme.desc: S01 E03 — Freezer Friendly Favorites Jamie turns frozen fish and veggies into a time saving supper. Then, Italian chef, Gennaro Contaldo rustles up some delicious homemade gnocchi using just 5 easy ingredients.

programme.title: Jamie Oliver's 5 Ingredient Mediterranean Meals
programme.desc: S01 E04 — Shake Up Your Salads Jamie's dressing a salad with a crown of cheese! He's also got a speedy twist on Sunday roast chicken and an elegant apple tart all with 5 fabulous ingredients.

programme.title: Gordon Ramsay's Ultimate Cooking Course
programme.desc: S01 E03 — Stress Free Cooking Gordon's tackles stress free cooking with recipes including sticky pork ribs, meatballs four ways and an amazing chilli chicken with ginger and coriander that just gets better and better with time.

programme.title: Hardcore Carnivore
programme.desc: S01 E01 — Alpine Lamb Ribs from Siddoway Sheep Company Jess joins the lamb-raising Siddoway family as they begin sorting the animals that are ready for processing. She then returns to the lodge, where she demonstrates how to prepare and grill lamb ribs.

programme.title: Hardcore Carnivore
programme.desc: S01 E02 — Smoked Elk Sandwiches at Juniper Mountain Ranch Jess and her friend Shaundi Campbell meet up with guides from Juniper Mountain Ranch in southeastern Idaho to cull an elk for her smoked elk sandwiches.

programme.title: Hardcore Carnivore
programme.desc: S01 E03 — Northstar Bison Smash Burger Jess visits Northstar Bison to learn about the small family-run ranch's breeding and processing operation, then prepares her signature smash burger.

programme.title: Hardcore Carnivore
programme.desc: S01 E04 — Cylon Rolling Acres Goat Birria Tacos Jess pitches in at Cylon Rolling Acres as owner Leslie Svacina runs her direct-to-consumer goat meat business.

programme.title: Hardcore Carnivore
programme.desc: S01 E05 — Fort Worth Barbacoa Feast Jess and her good friends, Fort Worth pitmaster Joe Riscky and Chef Juan Rodriguez, prepare a traditional barbacoa feast.

programme.title: Hardcore Carnivore
programme.desc: S01 E06 — Nashville Hot Dove Sliders at Redstone Ranch Jess and her husband Chris head to their favorite hunting grounds, Redstone Ranch, situated in the heart of the migratory dove flyway.

programme.title: Hardcore Carnivore
programme.desc: S01 E07 — Oklahoma's Wild Hog Sausage Roll Jess heads to Oklahoma, where she takes aim at one of the state's estimated 1.5 million feral hogs. Then, she makes a wild hog sausage roll with jalapeno and cheddar.

programme.title: Hardcore Carnivore
programme.desc: S01 E08 — Live Fire Venison Backstrap in Oklahoma With the help of a local Oklahoma guide, Jess sets out to hunt an axis deer, then shares butchery techniques and prepares a delicious backstrap grilled over live fire.

programme.title: Hardcore Carnivore
programme.desc: S01 E09 — South Texas Deer Capture Jess visits the East Foundation in South Texas to participate in a fast-paced, yet careful and methodical deer capture.

programme.title: Hardcore Carnivore
programme.desc: S01 E10 — Texas Tomahawk from Wyatt Ranches Jess heads to Wyatt Ranches in South Texas to check out the cattle ranching operation they've been running since 1965.

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
programme.desc: S04 E05 — Yakitori-Style Skewers and Pheasant Flatbread Andrew butchers a whole pheasant to make yakitori-style skewers and a homemade flatbread, cucumber salad and a mango chutney.

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
programme.desc: S02 E05 — Chicken Fried Deer and Creole Halibut Chef Andrew Zimmern prepares chicken fried axis deer. Next, Chef Zimmern poaches halibut in tomato roux.

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
programme.desc: S05 E10 — Wild Boar Feast: Chorizo with Mussels and Whole Roasted Leg Wild boar takes center stage! Andrew makes chorizo with mussels, preserved lemon & white wine. Then, he slow-roasts a whole leg over fire, served Southern-style with pickled cherries, glazed onions & mustard sauce.

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
programme.desc: S04 E08 — Crispy Duck Noodle Soup Andrew Zimmern transforms wild duck into a simple grilled appetizer inspired by Japanese tataki and then uses the rest of the duck to make open fire duck noodle soup with fresh egg noodles, lots of aromatic herbs, bean sprouts and squeeze of lime.

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
programme.desc: S02 E01 — Boar Ribs and Shrimp and Grits Chef Andrew Zimmern makes a homemade barbecue rub, basting sauce and barbecue sauce for wild boar ribs. Next, chef shares his twist on a classic southern shrimp and grits recipe, adding a side of beautiful wild mushrooms.

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

Served with grilled leeks and coal-roasted potatoes.

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
programme.desc: S03 E02 — Carne Adovada Chef Andrew Zimmern prepares Carne Adovada.

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
programme.desc: S04 E10 — Holy Mackerel! Andrew Zimmern champions the often-overlooked mackerel with a main salad of pickled filets, charred tomatoes, grilled frisée, and sweet summer peaches. Then, he grills it whole seasoned with caramelized onions, rutabaga mash and charred grapes.

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
programme.desc: S03 E01 — Grilled Turkey Legs, Creamed Greens and Lemon Orzo Chef Andrew Zimmern prepares Grilled Turkey Legs, Creamed Greens and Lemon Orzo.

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

He proves this small bird makes an extraordinary dinner.

programme.title: All Up In My Grill
programme.desc: S03 E03 — Feast of Killer Crab & Perfect Pork Belly Chef Dale Talde prepares a finger food feast with char grilled chili crab, spiced adobo potatoes, grilled pork belly, & sofrito stuffed branzino all served on a bed of rice over banana leaves. Call your friends - this is a feast that will feed many!

programme.title: All Up In My Grill
programme.desc: S03 E04 — Luxe Lobster & Prime Rib Chef Dale Talde pulls out all the stops for this daddy-sized dinner. He grills up prime rib with herb & horseradish crust, lobster & chili sauce American, charred green beans with garlic tahini, and cheddar-stuffed parker house rolls.

programme.title: All Up In My Grill
programme.desc: S03 E05 — Summer Seafood Smorgasbord Chef Dale Talde gets his beach vibes going with a grilled shrimp & lobster cocktail, clams with lemon breadcrumbs, a killer grilled king crab with burnt citrus butter, and a chilled mango frozen daiquiri. Don't you dare miss this beach party!

programme.title: All Up In My Grill
programme.desc: S03 E06 — Deluxe Dogs with Crusted Corn & Potatoes Chef Dale Talde puts a modern spin on a classic All-American cookout with his loaded hot dogs, spiced smashed potato salad, chorizo & corn nut crusted corn, and bangin' banana pudding pops. Sparklers out for this spread!

programme.title: All Up In My Grill
programme.desc: S03 E07 — Top of the Line Steaks Chef Dale Talde is back to level up his steak game by grilling up a NY strip steak with roasted onions & poblanos, short ribs with chili paste and horseradish, and a grilled chateaubriand with charred broccolini. Steak your claim on these dishes!

programme.title: All Up In My Grill
programme.desc: S03 E08 — Grilled Chicken 3 Ways Chef Dale Talde amps up your chicken dishes by making smoky chicken wings, a whole roasted turmeric ginger chicken with tamarind sauce, and chicken patties grilled in banana leaves with chili lime noodles. A frosty lime rickey finishes it all off!

programme.title: All Up In My Grill
programme.desc: S03 E09 — Scrumptious Summer Sandwiches Chef Dale Talde channels his inner sandwich lover by making an angry lobster club with pepper aioli and grilled bacon, a lamb birria torta with avocado and ramen consomme, and his an Italian beef combo with chili crisp cheese sauce, and giardiniera.

programme.title: All Up In My Grill
programme.desc: S03 E10 — A Festive & Flavorful Christmas in July Chef Dale Talde grills smoked ham and pineapple praline sliders, sweet potatoes with soy maple bacon, eggplant with labneh and cranberries, a holiday mezze plate and a grilled coquito cocktail.

programme.title: All Up In My Grill
programme.desc: S03 E11 — The Perfection of Pork Chef Dale Talde brings the heat when it comes to making perfect pork dishes including a root beer glazed pork banh mi, chorizo fried rice, Filipino sausage stuffed long hot peppers, and round it all out with a spicy grilled pineapple sundae.

programme.title: All Up In My Grill
programme.desc: S03 E12 — Tempting Tasty Tacos It's always taco night at Chef Dale's house! He turns up the heat with grilled salmon tacos with salsa verde & cauliflower escabeche, duck al pastor tacos with habanero pineapple salsa, & a smokey mushroom queso taco with truffle mole negro.

programme.title: Barbecue: Life of Fire

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
programme.desc: S04 E02 — Back to Our Caveman Roots Chef Andrew Zimmern goes primal with two antelope dishes: a Greek-style whole leg roasted over the open fire with a lemony avgolemono sauce and crispy potatoes, and a simple antelope tenderloin carpaccio served with roasted tomatoes and parmesan.

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
programme.desc: S04 E03 — Tailgate Tacos and Bison Bolognese Chef Andrew Zimmern starts simmering a classic Italian Bolognese sauce, with ground bison, lots of red wine and tomatoes. Then, he adds marinated bison skirt steak tacos with borracho beans to the tailgate menu.

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
programme.desc: S04 E08 — Crispy Duck Noodle Soup Andrew Zimmern transforms wild duck into a simple grilled appetizer inspired by Japanese tataki and then uses the rest of the duck to make open fire duck noodle soup with fresh egg noodles, lots of aromatic herbs, bean sprouts and squeeze of lime.

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
programme.desc: S05 E03 — Venison Paillard and Hearty Hunter's Stew Andrew Zimmern showcases venison two ways: a delicate grilled paillard with artichokes and parmesan, and a rich, slow-braised Polish hunter's stew with kielbasa, mushrooms, and sauerkraut. Served with grilled leeks and coal-roasted potatoes.

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
programme.desc: S05 E05 — The King of Open-Fire Paella Andrew Zimmern showcases quail two ways: classic Southern fried quail with lemon-basil aioli, and as an elevated topping for a traditional open-fire paella, complete with crispy socarrat. He proves this small bird makes an extraordinary dinner.

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
programme.desc: S05 E07 — Grilled Clams Casino and Garlicky Clam Pizza Andrew Zimmern celebrates cherrystone clams with two show-stopping recipes. He prepares classic grilled clams casino with pancetta, then pushes boundaries with an innovative grilled pizza topped with clams, garlic, chiles, and cheese.

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
programme.desc: S06 E04 — How to Cook a Whole Pig at Home Andrew tackles suckling pig with two recipes-his take on a three-cup braise with soy, rice wine, and sesame oil, served with plancha fried rice, and a whole pig roasted over open fire and pulled for Philly-style pork sandwiches with broccoli rabe.

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
programme.desc: S05 E10 — Wild Boar Feast: Chorizo with Mussels and Whole Roasted Leg Wild boar takes center stage! Andrew makes chorizo with mussels, preserved lemon & white wine. programme.title: Concentration
programme.desc: One of NBC's longest-running programs, this seminal game show was a daytime staple from 1958 to '73, with forays into prime time in '58 and '61. Of all the emcees who revealed the rebus (Ed McMahon and Bob Clayton among them), Hugh Downs is the one best remembered. In 1987, the series was resurrected as `Classic Concentration,' with Alex Trebek as host until the show's end in 1994.

programme.title: Saturdays In the South: A History of SEC Football Part One: 1869-1932
programme.desc: Part One: 1869-1932 In the aftermath of the Civil War, America's South is looking to put the past behind it, and finds one path in a growing cultural passion of the North - football. In December 1932, the Southeastern Conference is officially formed.

programme.title: Saturdays In the South: A History of SEC Football Part Two: 1933-1959
programme.desc: Part Two: 1933-1959 Multiple SEC schools claim national titles from the 1930s through the '50s, including LSU with star running back Billy Cannon in 1958, prior to Cannon's epic game-winning punt return against powerhouse Ole Miss a year later.

programme.title: Saturdays In the South: A History of SEC Football Part Three: 1960-1970
programme.desc: Part Three: 1960-1970 In the 1960s, as Georgia Tech leaves the conference and the Civil Rights Movement becomes embedded in the history and image of the region, Bear Bryant, hired in 1958, becomes the face of Alabama - and SEC football.

programme.title: Saturdays In the South: A History of SEC Football Part Four: 1969-1979
programme.desc: Part Four: 1969-1979 As a new decade dawns, quarterbacks Archie Manning, Bert Jones and Condredge Holloway build memorable legacies. Bear Bryant begins a new run of dominance at Alabama, and the rise of television sports transforms the SEC.

programme.title: Saturdays In the South: A History of SEC Football Part Five: 1980-1989
programme.desc: Part Five: 1980-1989 The 1980s begin with Herschel Walker leading Georgia to a national title as a freshman. After Bear Bryant retires in 1982 and passes away four weeks later, control of the SEC is eventually transferred to Pat Dye and Bo Jackson at Auburn.

programme.title: Saturdays In the South: A History of SEC Football Part Six: 1990-1999
programme.desc: Part Six: 1990-1999 The 1990s bring change, with expansion and the sport's first-ever conference championship game. Florida's Steve Spurrier fashions an era of high-octane offense, and his Gators form a rivalry with Tennessee and QB Peyton Manning.

programme.title: Saturdays In the South: A History of SEC Football Part Seven: 2000-2009
programme.desc: Part Seven: 2000-2009 Nick Saban comes to LSU in 2000 and eventually wins the Tigers' first national championship since 1958 - a feat matched by Les Miles. At Florida, Tim Tebow becomes a cult hero and wins two national titles with Urban Meyer's Gators.

programme.title: Saturdays In the South: A History of SEC Football Part Eight: 2010-Present
programme.desc: Part Eight: 2010-Present The SEC has a run of seven straight national titles, and nine in 12 years. Expansion in 2012 gives the conference 14 schools. Meanwhile, Nick Saban arguably becomes the greatest coach in the history of college football.
